# DOMPurify (vendored browser bundle)

Classic-script HTML sanitizer bundle for Utility Editor preview output.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Library | DOMPurify |
| Version | 3.2.6 |
| Bundle | `purify.min.js` |
| Source | https://unpkg.com/dompurify@3.2.6/dist/purify.min.js |
| Upstream | https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify |
| License | Apache License 2.0 / MPL 2.0 (see `LICENSE`) |
| Global | `window.DOMPurify` |

The upstream UMD distribution works as a classic script and requires no module loader. This copy is kept under the utility-editor namespace so the default static tree is self-contained; the existing Playground `vendor/purify.min.js` remains unchanged.
